crossing_in_the_woods.name: Crossing in the Woods
crossing_in_the_woods.summary: Wooded lanes and a central crossing. Ambush angles and flanks matter as much as raw VP sits.

goals: Plant early vision on the crossing
Take nearest munitions for grenade/mines fights
opening.marks_hint: Do not park an HMG on the open crossing without flank cover.

goals: Pressure enemy fuel with light AT
Keep a retreat path through green
mid.marks_hint: Mediums die cheaply if they crest the crossing blind.

goals: Collapse a flank into their HQ path
Hold two VPs with weapon teams
late.marks_hint: Late flanks beat frontal armor pushes here.

faymonville_approach.name: Faymonville Approach
faymonville_approach.summary: Ardennes approach map with layered cover. Infantry quality and flanks beat pure vehicle greed.

opening.marks_hint: Do not donate a support weapon on the forward ridge.

mid.marks_hint: Mid is a grind; upgrades matter.

late.marks_hint: Late game rewards the side that still has munitions for abilities.

kholodnaya_ferma.name: Kholodnaya Ferma
kholodnaya_ferma.summary: Eastern front fuel fight with open fields and farm cover. Vehicle timings punish slow tech.

opening.marks_hint: Far fuel is a trap until you have map move.

goals: AT gun or light armor before enemy mediums
Contest mid VP only with support
mid.marks_hint: Fields are kill zones; approach from farm cover.

goals: Lock a fuel and raid the other
late.marks_hint: One secure fuel + vision beats greedy double-fuel if you are behind.

kholodnaya_ferma_spring.name: Kholodnaya Ferma (Spring)
kholodnaya_ferma_spring.summary: Same skeleton as Ferma with spring sightlines. Treat fuels as the win condition.

opening.marks_hint: Same priorities as winter Ferma; watch longer sightlines.

mid.marks_hint: Punish overextended lights on the roads.

goals: Choose a side and collapse it
late.marks_hint: Do not split army across both fuels late.

langres.name: Langres
langres.summary: Classic 1v1 with clear fuel wings and a mid VP fight. Green cover favors MG and mortar holds more than greedy lights.

goals: Contest mid VP with infantry + one support weapon
opening.marks_hint: Play your start side fuel first. Do not bleed for far fuel before tier 2.

goals: Stabilize a cutoff if the enemy overextends
Bring medium armor only with vision
Trade munitions on upgrades that fight this minute
mid.marks_hint: Mid VPs decide income; rotate through cover rather than road marches.

late.marks_hint: Late game is about denying the enemy reset path to their remaining fuel.

road_to_kharkov.name: Road to Kharkov
road_to_kharkov.summary: Road network and layered VPs. Cutoffs and fuel denial decide more than a single heroic push.

opening.marks_hint: Road marches without vision get deleted.

mid.marks_hint: A cutoff is often worth more than a third VP briefly.

late.marks_hint: Win by starving fuel, not by chasing.

amilly_fields.name: Amilly Fields
amilly_fields.summary: Auto plan from scenario points (2 fuel, 3 VP markers extracted). Priorities are general; refine after a few games on this layout.

goals: Contest a VP with infantry + one support
opening.marks_hint: Follow resource markers on the tactical map.

goals: Field an AT answer before mediums dominate
mid.marks_hint: Rotate between VPs; do not deathball without vision.

late.marks_hint: Pick a win condition: fuel denial or VP grind.
